baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم ... أَرْدَىٰكُمْ ... فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun-verb doubling makes the supposition emphatically theirs, then assigns it the causative work of dropping them into a resultant state of diminution.

activation_trace.role: Weak conjecture is doubled as noun and verb, marking the belief they repeatedly made their own.
Lordship and sovereignty define the relation whose oversight they misestimate.
Falling into destruction supplies the downward causal result assigned to the conjecture.
Becoming a state turns the fall into an attained condition rather than a momentary blow.
General diminution names the class and condition into which they have become incorporated.

changed_reading.before: They held a wrong opinion about their Lord and were consequently punished.
changed_reading.after: Their repeatedly owned conjecture is itself made the operative cause that drops them into a settled condition of loss.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus root ranges from weak imagining to conviction after an indicator. Its repetition permits a weak estimate to be rehearsed into governing certainty about the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and imagining supply the insecure epistemic starting point.
Certainty after an indicator supplies the hardened endpoint that the doubled formulation can evoke.
Sovereign lordship makes the hardened estimate a governing model of divine rule, not an incidental guess.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns one mistaken idea.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a conjecture promoted by repetition into counterfeit certainty about how the Lord governs.

baseline_models.mechanism: A thought about the one who repairs, nurtures, and completes culminates in the opposite trajectory: they become diminished. The sequence reads as failed formation or anti-development.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion activate a formative dimension within the title Lord.
Destructive falling reverses the upward or completing trajectory of nurture.
Becoming marks the completed transition into the inverse state.
Diminution supplies the anti-formative endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Lord is only the object of their erroneous thought.
changed_reading.after: They misconstrue a formative relation to their Lord and consequently become its inverse: diminished rather than completed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence discloses the supposition as a practical model of limited observation: concealment seems possible because God is thought to know little. Bodily boundaries then become witnesses, while the surah closes with complete encompassing knowledge. The imagined blind zone reverses into total exposure.

activation_trace.role: Weak conjecture anchors the false observer-model in the focus.
Covering supplies the attempted concealment whose feasibility depends on the conjecture.
Testimony as declaration from knowledge reverses hidden conduct into evidence.
The body's skin or outer envelope becomes a witness, making the presumed boundary of privacy evidentiary.
Disclosure to the knower states the exact capacity their supposition wrongly limits.
Complete encompassing in knowledge eliminates every residual blind zone.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 moves from hearing, sight, and skin testifying to the explicit content of the focus supposition: God knows little of what they do.
41:54 closes the whole-surah frame by opposing limited knowledge with complete encompassment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, bodily testimony, the claim of limited knowledge, and total encompassment; I infer that the belief authorized reliance on blind zones and that exposure reverses that reliance. A live alternative is a purely forensic sequence with no prior behavioral authorization.

changed_reading.before: Their false belief simply merits punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their belief is a relied-upon surveillance premise: it licenses concealment, then destroys them when every supposed cover turns evidentiary inside an all-encompassing field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeats a reception architecture of heart-coverings, ear-weight, a preventing veil, refusal to understand, deliberate noise, and remote calling. The focus supposition is therefore not merely missing information; it is the cognitive product of a maintained input barrier.

activation_trace.role: Conjecture supplies the focus belief generated inside the obstructed reception system.
Protective covering supplies the inner enclosure they claim around their hearts.
Weight in the ear makes blocked reception materially heavy.
Prevention of access turns separation from the message into an asserted barrier.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that the failed input is practical, not merely acoustic.
The command not to understand turns passive deafness into an organized refusal.
Mixed noise supplies the active masking signal used to preserve that refusal.
Repeated ear-weight confirms the barrier as a sustained surah-wide condition.
Distance from proximity renders the final call perceptually remote.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 first presents turning away and non-hearing as claimed coverings and barriers.
41:26 converts non-hearing into a command plus masking noise, and 41:44 repeats ear-weight, blindness, and distant calling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated barriers and an active noise tactic; I infer a feedback loop that produces and preserves the focus supposition. The barrier claims could alternatively be polemical excuses rather than a psychological causal account.

changed_reading.before: The destructive supposition is an isolated intellectual mistake.
changed_reading.after: The destructive supposition is the output of a deliberately maintained reception system that blocks, masks, and distances corrective evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately after the focus introduces attached companions who beautify the temporal field before and behind them, then repeats their loser-status. The belief remains theirs, but its plausibility is socially curated by paired company.

activation_trace.role: The possessive doubled conjecture preserves personal ownership of the focus belief.
A companion coupled to another supplies the social attachment around the belief-holder.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the companions' evidence-curating function.
Repeated diminution carries the focus result into the socially furnished scene.

structural_cues: 41:25 follows the focus directly, pairs what is before with what is behind, and ends by repeating خاسرين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached companions, beautification, and repeated loss; I infer that companionship curates the horizon within which the supposition feels credible. A live alternative is that the companions only intensify deeds after the belief is already fixed.

changed_reading.before: Your supposition is wholly private cognition.
changed_reading.after: Your supposition remains accountable as yours, yet it is stabilized within a companion-driven environment that beautifies the evidence horizon around you.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus range from conjecture to certainty is sharpened by a surah that presents guidance and signs yet depicts blindness as preferred. Signs in horizons and selves are ordered toward disclosure of truth, so the condemned certainty is counterfeit not because evidence is absent but because its reception is inverted.

activation_trace.role: Weak imagining supplies the epistemically under-supported side of the focus belief.
Conviction after an indicator supplies the certainty-status falsely claimed by that belief.
Gentle direction to the right path supplies available orientation rather than evidentiary absence.
Heart-attached preference makes blindness selected rather than merely suffered.
Blindness of insight names the preferred mode that inverts guidance.
Manifest signs provide the indicators against which the focus certainty is measured.
Emergence into visibility supplies the signs' intended disclosure.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the disclosed object their certainty misses.

structural_cues: 41:17 grammatically places preferred blindness over guidance.
41:53 moves from signs in horizons and selves toward truth becoming clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, guidance, chosen blindness, disclosure, and the focus root's certainty/conjecture range; I infer hardening from weak estimate into felt certainty. A live alternative is stubborn preference without a temporal hardening process.

changed_reading.before: Their thought is wrong because they lack knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their thought is counterfeit certainty produced by preferring blindness even as available signs are ordered toward disclosure of the truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured provision, willing cosmic compliance, and the growth of revived earth activate the Lord's formative branch. Against that field, the focus sequence Lord-destruction-becoming-loss is an inversion of cultivation: the false model of the nurturer makes its holders become diminished within a life-producing order.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make Lordship the focus anchor for a formative reading.
Becoming supplies the developmental transition whose direction is at issue.
Diminution supplies the inverse outcome of nurture and completion.
Measured governance by deliberated apportionment supplies an ordered formative environment.
Sustenance that maintains life supplies the nutritive content of that environment.
Willing compliance supplies the creation's aligned response to formative command.
Nourishment and growth activate a root-neighboring image of earth rising under life-giving provision.
Earth enlivened by rain and vegetation completes the cultivation axis.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 orders creation through measured provisions and willing response.
41:39 reprises creation as a visible transition from humbled earth to movement, growth, and life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, measure, sustenance, compliance, growth, and life; I infer that focus loss is an inverse cultivation caused by misalignment with that order. It may alternatively remain punishment language with no developmental mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Lord punishes an incorrect opinion from outside it.
changed_reading.after: The incorrect model of the nurturing Lord reverses formation itself: within an order that measures, feeds, and revives, its holders become diminished.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reward, earning, recompense, and the paired for-self/upon-self syntax establish a self-returning account. The focus trade-loss branch then renders the destructive supposition as a commitment whose realized return consumes capital rather than as an arbitrary external debit.

activation_trace.role: An affair with an untrusted outcome makes the supposition a badly assessed commitment.
Commercial loss and lost capital supply the focus accounting image.
Compensation for work supplies the positive side of the surah's return structure.
Cutting off an extension, explicitly negated in the source, contrasts enduring reward with terminal loss.
Seeking and obtaining a return makes conduct an earning activity.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies settlement rather than arbitrary imposition.
Intentional action supplies the item whose consequence returns to its actor.
Harmful doing supplies the negative side explicitly placed upon the self.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances whoever acts rightly, for his own self, against whoever does evil, upon it.
The focus itself makes their own supposition the grammatical cause of their loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reward, earning, recompense, self-returning action, and trade loss; I infer that the thought functions as an accountable commitment within the same ledger. An alternative keeps cognition and action as separate account entries.

changed_reading.before: They are labeled losers after judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their own supposition settles back upon them as a ruinous return, realizing the loss of the very capital on which they relied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence oscillates from severed hope under harm to entitlement under mercy, where the same supposition-Lord pairing denies the Hour yet presumes the best outcome. The focus thought is thus exposed as condition-dependent self-protection rather than a stable doctrine.

activation_trace.role: An affair whose outcome cannot be trusted anchors the focus as a distorted forecast.
Severed hope supplies the first pole of the condition-dependent forecast.
A second image of severed hope intensifies collapse under adverse conditions.
Merciful tenderness supplies the favorable condition that is converted into self-entitlement.
Harm as diminution supplies the adverse condition from which the entitlement rebounds.
The repeated conjecture explicitly forecasts that the Hour will not stand.
The repeated Lord relation reconnects the later forecast directly to the focus object.
The good as opposite of bad supplies the outcome confidently reserved for the self.

structural_cues: 41:49-50 pivots from despair under touched harm to this-is-mine after mercy, then joins ظن, the Hour, return, and Lord in one forecast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adversity/despair and mercy/entitlement oscillation plus the repeated supposition-Lord pair; I infer one condition-responsive theological habit. The later speaker could alternatively instantiate a related type rather than explain every addressee in 41:23.

changed_reading.before: Their thought about the Lord is one fixed proposition.
changed_reading.after: Their thought is a self-protective forecasting habit: present harm cuts off hope, present mercy becomes entitlement, accountability is discounted, and a favorable return is still presumed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the causative form conventionally conveys destruction, while the same root inventory also carries a cloak adhering to the shoulders. Nearby skin and concealment keep the material overlay anchored: their supposition behaves like a covering worn against observation, but the body's own covering testifies. Downstream prose should present this as a secondary root-image reversal, never as a replacement translation of أَرْدَىٰكُمْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرْدَىٰكُمْ, activated through the root's cloak branch beside the immediate concealment and skin sequence.

activation_trace.role: A cloak adhering to the shoulders supplies the focus-side image of a belief worn as cover.
Skin as the body's envelope becomes testimony, reversing the protective surface into evidence.
Covering names the concealment function that the figurative cloak fails to perform.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the supposition they wore as an epistemic covering becomes their undoing when the body's own covering turns witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أَصْبَحْتُم most directly marks becoming, not literal dawn. It remains anchored in the focus root's morning branch and is activated by lamps, daylight opening, and disclosure elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should qualify it as an illumination undertone: their attained loss is brought to light, without replacing the state-change syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَأَصْبَحْتُم, retaining state-change while reopening the root's morning and illumination field.

activation_trace.role: Becoming preserves the focus construction's primary transition into a new state.
Morning and first light supply a secondary disclosure image within that transition.
Lamps and illumination activate the light-bearing side of the shared focus root.
Daylight opening by brightness extends the transition from hiddenness to visibility.
Emergence and disclosure make the final state publicly intelligible.

changed_reading.after: They became losers, with an exploratory undertone that this status dawned into visibility and could no longer remain concealed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes an abstract supposition as a throwing vector. It remains tightly anchored in أَرْدَىٰكُمْ through both the throwing and destructive-fall branches, while 41:40 supplies an explicit casting scene. Downstream prose may say the thought functions like the force that hurls them, but should not claim that the verb lexically means their thought was a stone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرْدَىٰكُمْ, where throwing and falling-to-destruction coexist in the focus inventory.

activation_trace.role: Throwing with stone or rock supplies the launch image assigned to the supposition.
Falling into destruction supplies the trajectory's terminal result.
Casting something until it lies thrown supplies a visible context analogue for the focus trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Their thought is an abstract reason for destruction.
changed_reading.after: Their thought functions as the very throwing force that converts an inward estimate into an outward fall toward destruction.

strongest_changes: The focus supposition becomes a relied-upon blind-spot model that collapses when bodily coverings testify inside complete divine encompassment.
The belief is neither information-poor nor wholly private: maintained non-hearing, masking noise, preferred blindness, and beautifying companions stabilize it against disclosed signs.
The Lord-becoming-loss sequence reads both as inverse formation within a sustaining order and as a self-returning account in which the supposition realizes its own loss.
The later supposition-Lord recurrence exposes a condition-dependent forecast that alternates between despair, entitlement, denial of accountability, and presumed favorable return.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet changed a generic bad-thought reading into interacting epistemic, sensory, social, formative, and accounting mechanisms while preserving material root-images as contained outliers rather than forced translations.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from blocked reception and companion beautification to the specific focus supposition are reader inferences; the packet also permits these as parallel descriptions of refusal.
The nurture-growth and commercial-accounting readings are branch-driven overlays and need not displace the direct judgment-and-loss reading.
The cloak, dawn, and projectile activations remain secondary material resonances and should not replace the ordinary syntax of destruction and becoming.
